market_brief: Price data is from Wednesday's 20:30 UTC snapshot: S&P 500 -0.4% (fifth straight loss), Dow -1.2%, Nasdaq 100 flat, 10Y ~5.07%, DXY ~103.8, with gold (-3.5%), silver (-5%), copper (-5.3%), oil (-4.5%) and BTC (-3.7% to ~$62.5k) hit by hawkish FOMC minutes. Overnight the AI-hardware selloff spread to Asia: Taiwan's TAIEX fell 4.6% with chip/PCB names limit-down, the Hang Seng lost ~1.8% and Kospi ~1.1%, even as US futures firmed (~+0.8% S&P) ahead of Anthropic's 9:30 ET debut and Walmart's results. India is a relative outperformer: the Sensex turned ~0.5% higher by midday on PSU banks after Rs5,867 crore of FII buying, with the rupee near 93.5. Gold briefly broke $3,700 before steadying; markets still price ~90% odds of a December Fed hike.
ai_brief: Anthropic (ANT) starts trading today after an upsized 980M-share IPO at $83, with the prospectus showing ~$17B Q3 revenue and a $26B strategic placement. The pricing war at the frontier is the other theme: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra cut prices 20% to $8/$40, Microsoft's MAI models pitch near-frontier coding at a fraction of the cost, and Gemini 4 Neon sits at $3/$15. OpenAI's embedded safety-assessor programme drew criticism, and funding stayed heavy (Science Corp, Model ML, Boltz).

items.headline: Taiwan's TAIEX plunges 4.6% as AI-hardware rout deepens; chip and PCB names limit-down
items.summary: The TAIEX fell 4.6% to 38,347.67 (OTC index -6.6%), leaving it down ~9% on the week; Global Unichip, Nan Ya PCB and Kinsus hit limit-down while TSMC lost 1.6%. New US licence rules for chip exports to Southeast Asia and Brazil, hawkish Fed minutes and a third day of foreign selling (NT$76.6B net on Nov 18) drove the move.

items.headline: Asian stocks slip as Anthropic's record IPO fails to lift sentiment
items.summary: By ~02:30 GMT the Hang Seng was down 1.8%, Kospi -1.1% and Shanghai -0.8%, while the Nikkei held a small gain near 59,140. USD/JPY sat around 159.4 and Brent steadied near $92 after Wednesday's slide.

items.headline: Sensex reverses early IT-led losses, up ~420 points by midday; Nifty above 25,350
items.summary: After opening lower on IT weakness (Infosys, TCS, HCL Tech) and Fed-hike nerves, the Sensex rose 0.5% to ~82,454 and the Nifty to ~25,355 by noon IST. PSU lenders extended their run, with SBI, PNB and Bank of India up ~27% in November so far.

items.headline: Update: rupee eases 8 paise to 93.49 as DXY nears 103.9; FIIs bought Rs5,867 crore Wednesday
items.summary: The rupee slipped to 93.49 per dollar in early trade from 93.41, tracking a firm dollar index (~103.9). Supporting factors: foreign investors were net buyers of Rs5,866.78 crore in cash equities on Nov 18 and Brent eased to ~$91.7.

items.headline: Update: gold briefly breaks below $3,700, then steadies near a 14-month low
items.summary: Spot gold touched $3,693, its lowest since September 2025, before holding around $3,723 by 04:52 GMT; silver edged up to ~$45. CME FedWatch shows ~90% odds of a 25bp December Fed hike and ~10% for 50bp.

items.headline: US futures firm ahead of ANT debut; Palo Alto jumps ~10% on beat and Applied Compute deal
items.summary: S&P 500 futures were ~+0.8% and Nasdaq 100 futures ~+1.3% in overnight trade. Palo Alto closed +9.9% after its fiscal Q1 beat (revenue +39% to $3.44B); Amazon gained 3.8%.

items.headline: European shares seen opening firmer after three-day slide
items.summary: Futures pointed to a modestly higher open for Europe after Wednesday's ~1% drop led by miners, with attention on Anthropic's US debut and gold steadying around $3,730.

items.headline: Update: Anthropic upsized to 980M shares; ANT opens on Nasdaq at 9:30 ET today
items.summary: New detail: the deal was upsized to 980M Class A shares at $83 (~$81.3B raised) plus a planned ~$26B placement with AMD, Broadcom, Google, Microsoft and Nvidia. The filing shows Q3 revenue of nearly $17B (+45% q/q) and $6.2B of debt.

items.headline: Morningstar puts Anthropic fair value at $92, ~11% above the IPO price
items.summary: Morningstar's fair-value estimate of $92 per share was cited in coverage of the pricing, offering an early independent valuation marker before the first trade.

items.headline: Walmart reports Q3 pre-market: Street expects $0.64 EPS on ~$187.3B revenue
items.summary: Walmart reports before the open with consensus at $0.64 EPS and ~$187.27B revenue; the stock fell ~10% after its previous report but is up ~13% YTD. Commentary on holiday demand and tariff costs is the main focus.

items.headline: Nvidia interim CEO Kress defends ~$500B customer-financing programme
items.summary: In post-earnings comments, interim CEO Colette Kress defended a roughly $500B financing programme arranged with Goldman Sachs, BlackRock and Apollo, which has drawn investor concern; NVDA fell ~2.9% Wednesday despite a beat-and-raise.

items.headline: Update: Trump-Xi talks open in Shenzhen with low expectations for breakthroughs
items.summary: Talks began in Shenzhen at APEC, with Xi reportedly calling ties stable. Analysts expect few concrete outcomes; the Busan trade truce runs to Jan 10, 2027, and CSIS estimates Chinese rare-earth exports to the US remain ~75% below normal.

items.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO gets a muted start, subscribed 0.05x by midday on day one
items.summary: The Coal India subsidiary's IPO was only ~5% subscribed by 12:19 IST on its opening day; institutional books typically fill later in the window.

items.headline: Today/next: ANT first trade, Walmart pre-market, APEC wraps; RBI MPC Dec 2-4, FOMC Dec 8-9
items.summary: Thursday: Anthropic's first trade at 9:30 ET, Walmart Q3 before the open, US weekly jobless claims and the close of APEC. Next: RBI policy Dec 2-4 and the FOMC Dec 8-9, where a hike is ~90% priced.

items.headline: Anthropic's IPO prospectus details: ~$17B Q3 revenue, $26B strategic placement with chip and cloud partners
items.summary: Alongside the $83 IPO (upsized to 980M shares), Anthropic plans a ~$26B placement with AMD, Broadcom, Google, Microsoft and Nvidia. Q3 revenue was close to $17B, up 45% from Q2; trading begins today as ANT.

items.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra at $8/$40, a 20% price cut, plus GPT-6.2 Sol
items.summary: Astra targets complex professional work at $8 input/$40 output per M tokens; Sol keeps $2/$10. Artificial Analysis scores Astra 62 vs Claude Fable 5.2 at 65, and OpenAI says Astra is the first released model at its 'High' self-improvement threshold.

items.headline: Microsoft launches in-house MAI model family at Ignite, pitching cheap coding
items.summary: Microsoft unveiled MAI models including MAI Code 2, reportedly claiming ~96% of Claude Opus 5.5's coding performance at ~5% of the cost, adding to this week's frontier price war.

items.headline: OpenAI's 'embedded assessors' safety programme criticised as narrower than promised
items.summary: OpenAI named four outside safety groups, including Apollo Research, as embedded assessors. Researchers told NPR access is limited (few may speak to staff, no internal Slack), short of the 'employee-like access' Altman floated in September.

items.headline: Funding roll: Science Corp $400M, Model ML $250M at $1.5B, Boltz $110M, Linq $90M
items.summary: Per a daily round-up: Science Corp raised a $400M Series D, Model ML a $250M Series B at $1.5B, Boltz a $110M Series A led by Bessemer, and Linq a $90M Series B led by a16z; Sierra is reportedly in early talks at ~$30B.

items.headline: Robotics: Boston Dynamics Atlas to trial in GlobalFoundries fabs; Foundation unveils Phantom MKII
items.summary: Boston Dynamics plans Atlas humanoid trials in GlobalFoundries fabs from early 2027, and Foundation showed its Phantom MKII humanoid with Cortex II control software aimed at heavy industry and defence.

items.headline: SpaceX says orbital compute largely self-funded; ~$4B bond reportedly part of $40B Vera Rubin plan
items.summary: SpaceX's CFO outlined Starmind compute satellites from 2027 and gigawatt scale by 2029; Bloomberg reportedly said a ~$4B bond sale sits within a $40B Nvidia Vera Rubin financing plan.

items.headline: Trending repos: API-gateway projects sub2api and new-api, plus vercel/eve
items.summary: A daily AI digest flags Wei-Shaw/sub2api and QuantumNous/new-api (LLM API relay/gateway tools) and vercel/eve among trending GitHub repositories.
